title: Start of session 1
body_text:
You will now start the first session of the main experiment. As a reminder, the structure of the experiment is described in the diagram below.


The session will start with two training tasks, that will not count towards your score and your bonus remuneration.

Then, the recorded section will start, in which you will have to complete 2 tasks, 1 survey, another 2 tasks and another survey. There is no right or wrong answers to the surveys; only your score during the recorded task will count towards your bonus remuneration.

From now on, you will not be informed if each decision was correct or incorrect. You will be informed when the recorded section starts.
